full_judgment: 10. It appears that the High Court Division without adverting to the reasonings and findings given by the lower appellate court reversed those findings. It further appears that the High Court Division observed that the findings of fact arrived at by the trial court upon exhaustive consideration of the documentary and oral evidence having not controverted by the court of appeal below, the judgment of the court of appeal below is not a proper judgment of the reversal.
